results.title: Body Check
results.overview: A woman obsessively body-checks in her bathroom, lost in a ritual of control and self-surveillance. From the window next door, a young girl watches, silently inheriting the script of womanhood, where beauty and self-critique are learned side by side.

results.title: My Mother the Madam
results.overview: When an investigative reporter returns home to attend her father's funeral, she not only discovers that she's adopted but that her mother is a powerful madam who may be responsible for her father's death.

results.title: Button Pusher
results.overview: A broken air conditioner, a cancelled coworker, and a cheating husband.  A hair braider struggles to maintain composure after finding out her client is having an affair with her husband.

results.title: Pig Hill
results.overview: Carrie has been fascinated by the local legend of the pig people of Pig Hill, revolting creatures who breed and cause havoc in the area. As the tenth woman goes missing, Carrie can't stop thinking that there could be more to these stories.

results.title: Red Pocket
results.overview: A magical Red Pocket interrupts an anxiety ridden family dinner.

results.title: Film this!
results.overview: Two filmmakers must set aside their history to film a crucial scene. Egos clash and tensions rise as everything unravels before day's end. A film that could only have been made once, shot sequentially, without takes, always in character.

results.original_title: La vie ne tient qu'à un Cornichon

results.title: Tracking in Blood
results.overview: After using an Ouija board to ask the spirits about their future, a group of friends and their family members slowly start disappearing when stories of a spirit lurking in the mountains appear to come true.

results.title: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! Act 1
results.original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー もっとらぶらぶ作戦です！ 第1幕
results.overview: Part 1 of the spin-off comedy series from Girls und Panzer.

results.title: Good Name Heavy II
results.overview: Sequel to the popular Israeli rap opera starring Tamir Bar. Shem Tov Heavy successfully escaped from prison and has lived under a fake identity for the last few years. When he goes on the run again, he finds himself in a fictional city called "Ya Hood", where he is praised as the "Shaliah".

results.title: December Evening
results.overview: Student Annika returns home for Christmas, but the anticipation of the family dinner is overshadowed by tensions: stepfather Thomas invites business partners, mother Monika is focused on sister Maya’s career, and uncle Detlef stirs things up with his comments. When Maya decides she’d rather celebrate with her boyfriend Barir, Annika covers for her with a lie.

results.title: September, All Over
results.overview: In the sweltering aftermath of Hurricane Irma, 22-year-old Talia has an unexpected fling with a much older neighbor that will stick with her forever.

results.title: If You See Something
results.overview: In the bliss of their new love, Ali and Katie start to build their life together in New York City, he as an Iraqi immigrant seeking political asylum and she, an ambitious American woman. When a crisis strikes back in Baghdad in the thick of his asylum process, Ali and Katie are forced to navigate its impact on their relationship... and the secrets they have been keeping from each other.

results.title: Il Damo
results.overview: Ferdinando stopped talking to people eight years ago. In the solitude of his Milan apartment, he cooks, practices singing, and does some rather unusual exercises. He is paid to keep company to Genziana, a wealthy, cultured woman who feels the need to connect with a deep soul akin to her own.

results.title: CHOKE ECHO
results.overview: This isn’t a film. It’s a leaked ritual.  Somewhere between analog prayer and digital disease, a collection of gestures tried to become human again. They failed.  Children orbit the fence like insects around an electric hymn. A figure holds a violin but never plays — his silence is louder than the sound. The man in the branches hasn’t fallen in years. The killer appears, or doesn’t — but you’ll feel him beneath the cuts, mouthing things you’ll wish you didn’t understand.  There are bodies, sometimes clothed in flesh, sometimes not.  There is scripture, mangled and reversed — not to mock it, but to unlock it. The voice speaks, but only when you stop listening.  This is the place where lost footage remembers you. Where noise prays back.  CHOKE ECHO was compiled under duress by 0xHamza in 2025 using material never meant to be rearranged. Watch it if you must — but it will keep watching after you close the tab.

results.title: Can You Hear Me?
results.overview: A fallen WWI American soldier strikes a divine bargain to reunite with his bride in England. As he resumes life unaware he's a ghost, love and loss blur. When Annabel learns the truth-now carrying his child-she must face heartbreak and find the strength to let him go.

results.title: Fatna, A Woman Named Rachid
results.overview: After surviving arbitrary detention and torture for her political activism in 1970’s Morocco, Fatna El Bouih continues to pursue relentlessly today, her dream for change.
